description.value: Mount Currie Coffee Co. is a locally rooted coffee shop with two locations serving the Sea-to-Sky corridor — Pemberton and Whistler Village — pouring premium espresso drinks from Gradient Coffee roasted just up the road in the Pemberton Industrial Park. Active supporters of both PORCA and WORCA, they co-sponsor annual mountain bike events and describe themselves as 'a place to start your adventure,' making them a natural gathering spot for cyclists in the region. Call-ahead ordering is available for groups heading out on the trails.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (100 spaces, covered) at 42m. Total: 100 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM address (7331 Arbutus Street) matches the Pemberton location listed on the website (2-7331 Arbutus Street, Pemberton, BC V0N 2L1), confirming this record represents the Pemberton café, though the OSM community tag says 'Whistler' — likely a community assignment error. The website is active and confirms year-round operation, call-ahead and grab-and-go service, and active co-sponsorship of PORCA and WORCA mountain biking events. No specific amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'Whistler' but the address (7331 Arbutus Street) corresponds to the Pemberton location; the Whistler location is at 103-4369 Main Street — possible community assignment error in OSM.
Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Mount Currie Coffee Company' but the website consistently uses 'Mount Currie Coffee Co.'
OSM has no phone number; Pemberton location phone (604) 894-3388 sourced from website.
OSM address omits unit number; website shows '2-7331 Arbutus Street'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, year-round coffee shop with confirmed Pemberton location, active website, and strong ties to the local cycling community via PORCA and WORCA sponsorships.
